name: x-mod-guard
description: reads every Bash call, fork spawn and Write before it runs: a Write over a tracked file the session never read, a floor command, a system, overwrite, prune or remote-delete command, a known hazard shape, a coder spawn whose brief has no x brief check stamp, or a fork with no why-fork line is refused with its safe door, never a dialog; each refusal and escape is kept in its own store as an event and a per-day count, which x-mod-stash's band reads as its 🛡️ counter row
